payload.question: Did the council set up the emergency fund it promised for reorganisation?
payload.label: A ring-fenced Readiness Fund for reorganisation and inflation costs

target.display: "The proposed Readiness Fund, a ring-fenced fund to manage in-year financial pressures, including costs associated with Local Government Reorganisation and inflation." — Cabinet, 11 February 2026

payload.council_caveat: Local government reorganisation is the national programme that may abolish Norwich City Council and fold it into a larger authority. Every forecast the council publishes beyond 2026/27 carries that caveat, put there by the council itself.
payload.evidence: The council said it would ring-fence a fund to cover the costs of reorganisation and inflation during 2026/27. Whether it did, and what it was spent on, will not be visible until the year's accounts are published in summer 2027.
